support_email.description: Contact Support email address. Read by the client Profile screen. Can be changed without an app update.

min_supported_app_version.description: Minimum supported app version. Clients below this version see a force-upgrade screen.

feature_flags.description: Feature flags for gradual rollout and kill switches.

simplify_debts_recompute_v2.description: Kill switch for the v2 simplified-debts recomputation algorithm. When true, Cloud Functions use the v2 path.
